title: git.commit_made record
description: One commit, as the program that made it saw it at that moment: one JSON object a line in git-commits.jsonl. The commit is named by its sha, so a reader joins the record to the commit on vcs.ref.head.revision. A key with no value is left out rather than written empty.

timestamp.description: When the writer recorded the commit, by its own clock, in UTC to the millisecond. git's own dates are whole seconds.

name.description: The event's name, which a log pipeline moves to the record's body.

resource.description: The record's OpenTelemetry resource as comma-separated key=value pairs, naming git as its service.

fleet.schema_version.description: This shape's version. A change to a key's name or meaning raises it.

trace_id.description: The W3C trace id of the span the commit was made under, from the writer's TRACEPARENT.

span_id.description: The W3C span id of the span the commit was made under, from the writer's TRACEPARENT.

vcs.repository.name.description: The repo's short name: the last segment of its origin URL, without .git.

vcs.ref.head.name.description: The branch HEAD was on. Left out where HEAD was detached, as it is during a rebase or a merge made onto a detached base.

session.id.description: The Claude Code session that made the commit. Left out for a commit made outside one.

fleet.commit.parents.description: The commit's parent shas in git's order, so a merge's first parent is the branch it was made on. Empty for a root commit.

fleet.agent.name.description: Which kind of agent made the commit, such as claude-code, claude-code/<pane handle>, claude-code-unattended or claude-code-unattended/<scheduled job>.

fleet.run.id.description: The scheduled run that started the session, from FLEET_RUN_ID.

fleet.flow.id.description: The flow the writer's BAGGAGE carried as fleet.flow.id: a W3C trace id, never all zeros. Left out where BAGGAGE carried none or a malformed one, and a reader resolves the flow from the session's worklog at the record's time.
